description: This file defines a Kotlin class `PermissionRequester` for managing runtime permission requests in an Android application. It handles requesting permissions, showing rationales, and guiding users to app settings if permissions are denied.

classes.name: PermissionRequester
classes.description: A class to manage requesting runtime permissions in an Android app, with rationale dialogs and settings redirection.

methods.name: requestIfMissing
methods.description: Requests specified permissions if they are not already granted, handles rationale display, and possibly prompts the user to app settings.

methods.name: showRationaleDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog explaining why permissions are needed, and waits for user response.

methods.name: showSettingsDialog
methods.description: Shows a dialog prompting the user to open app settings to manually enable permissions.

methods.name: buildRationaleMessage
methods.description: Constructs a message explaining why certain permissions are required.

methods.name: buildSettingsMessage
methods.description: Constructs a message guiding the user to enable permissions in settings.

methods.name: permissionLabel
methods.description: Converts permission strings to user-friendly labels.
